tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database performance tuning. Proven delivery of data pipelines, API integrations, and quality assurance workflows across enterprise systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] We're Hiring | SFCC QA Engineer – Salesforce Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your team as an engineer supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms. With over 5 years of hands-on backend and platform experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in e-commerce workflows, integrations, and rigorous testing practices.

bullets.label: Platform & Quality Assurance
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit to maintain high code quality, coverage, and platform stability across enterprise e-commerce applications.

bullets.label: API Development & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, customizing Interceptors and Populators to ensure robust data exchange and system reliability.

bullets.label: Data Pipelines & Validation
bullets.text: Designed and optimized complex data pipelines using Hotfolders, DataHub, and Profisee to synchronize product catalogs and verify data integrity across global channels.

bullets.label: System Analysis & Support
bullets.text: Gathered requirements, executed user acceptance testing (UAT), and resolved integration bottlenecks between ERP and e-commerce platforms working with international teams.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise can support your projects.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to this opportunity because of your commitment to building high-performing enterprise e-commerce platforms. My extensive background in backend development, API integration, and rigorous testing at global organizations like Rockwell Automation and Shell aligns closely with your technical standards and delivery goals.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, API integration, and rigorous testing experience to your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Shivani, I saw your opening for the Commerce Cloud role. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms, APIs, and test suites at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I'd love to connect. I am based in Germany with a valid work permit. Best, Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Kranti Chavan – [Post] We're Hiring | SFCC QA Engineer
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Commerce Cloud role. With over 5 years of professional experience building, testing, and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in backend development, API integrations, and quality assurance.

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
